name: Crystal Kelp Frond
summary: Murlocs carry Crystal Kelp Fronds from the ocean to Crystal Lake in Elwynn Forest. William Pestle in Goldshire seeks them for an invisibility liquor.

sections.title: A Rare Aquatic Reagent
sections.body: Crystal Kelp Fronds come from saltwater oceans, so their presence in Elwynn Forest’s fresh water is unusual. Murloc tribes along Crystal Lake’s shores gather and keep the fronds for reasons of their own. Alchemists value their strange power to distort sight. William Pestle in Goldshire uses them as the chief ingredient in an invisibility liquor, meant to help sweethearts slip past watchful family eyes.

faq.q: Where does crystal kelp naturally grow?
faq.answer: Crystal kelp grows in saltwater oceans. It is not native to freshwater lakes, though murlocs gather the cuttings and carry them to places such as Crystal Lake.

faq.q: Why do the murlocs at Crystal Lake have ocean kelp?
faq.answer: The entry gives no reason the murlocs at Crystal Lake have ocean kelp. It says they gather and keep the fronds for reasons of their own.

faq.q: Who wants Crystal Kelp Fronds in Goldshire?
faq.answer: William Pestle, an apothecary at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, wants Crystal Kelp Fronds. He uses them to brew invisibility liquor for Maybell Maclure, so she can slip away from her family vineyard to meet Tommy Joe Stonefield.

faq.q: What properties does crystal kelp possess?
faq.answer: Alchemists value crystal kelp fronds for their ability to distort sight. William Pestle uses them in an invisibility liquor meant to help sweethearts pass unseen.

angles.text: Crystal Kelp Fronds are aquatic, unlike herbs rooted in soil, and do not grow in standard herb nodes across Elwynn. Herbalists and gatherers must pry them from local murlocs, who keep the fronds.
